source.scope: Only this optimization folder is added. No existing application or solver is changed.

metricDefinition: Scaled error = abs(computed - oracle) / max(1, abs(oracle)); not a universal relative physical error. Comparisons reuse stated material constants but independent analytic/linear algebra/geometry oracles.

checks: Wright compressed-wire linear results are withheld
Landing active-set singularity gives no feasible optimum
Zero beam length gives readable error; reset recovers
BO shows actual counts: 30 BO, 25 grid, 30 random under budget cap 30

repairs: Refuse singular, cycling and unconverged unilateral active sets
Re-activate stretched released cables in failsafe model
Reject compressed-wire candidates across sizing, shape and failsafe; withhold reliability estimates for invalid linear-wire models
Reject non-finite loads; fix zero-scatter strict-exceedance boundary
Default sizing to valid Warren demo; label budget cap and model verification accurately
Replace filled bar charts with category points and distribution profiles; hide penalty values from mass profiles
scope: Numerical verification and educational usability review. No experimental, ANSYS, nonlinear geometric, aeroelastic or low-Re wing validation. Fresh model feasibility is not a proof of global optimality.

moduleAssessment.beam-section-map: Useful feasibility and bound-awareness teaching; buckling is not modeled.
moduleAssessment.beam-fsd: Useful strength/stiffness trade-offs; section floors alter ideal zero-tip ratios.
moduleAssessment.beam-supports: Useful support/influence-line studies within Euler-Bernoulli assumptions.
moduleAssessment.truss-sizing: Useful Warren and linear comparison studies; compressed wires cannot be admitted.
moduleAssessment.truss-topology: Useful LP/OC contrast; LP plastic strength and elastic verification are distinguished; buckling not globally optimized.
moduleAssessment.truss-failsafe: Useful conditional load-case and scatter studies; independence/distribution assumptions and cable admission matter.
moduleAssessment.truss-shape: Useful local geometry search; singular cable branches withheld; no global guarantee.
moduleAssessment.wingbox-sensitivity: Useful simplified EI/GJ and sensitivity studies; not the existing Wing Lab model.
moduleAssessment.pareto-nsga2: Useful sampled Pareto fronts; convergence on a teaching problem does not prove global optimality.
moduleAssessment.constrained-bo: Useful optimizer/GP teaching; actual evaluation counts differ under a common cap, GP probabilities are model-conditional.

existingApplications: No existing application file is modified by this release.
